khse01.title: Aries buzzed in before the question
khse01.caption:
Already texted first and now refreshing every ten seconds?
A fast heart is a good heart. Give them room to catch up.

khse02.title: Taurus made the hot seat cozy
khse02.caption:
Ever stayed in something just because it felt familiar?
Comfortable and happy aren't always the same thing.

khse03.title: Gemini gave two answers
khse03.caption:
Forty drafts for one text, and none of them sound like you?
The real one is the one worth sending.

khse04.title: Cancer kept the voice note
khse04.caption:
Still have the voice note you can't bring yourself to delete?
The love was real. You get to keep that part without the replay.

khse05.title: Leo took the microphone
khse05.caption:
The loudest one in the room might be the one asking, are we okay?
Needing reassurance doesn't make you less of a star.

khse06.title: Virgo fact-checked the host
khse06.caption:
You're everyone's fixer, but who checks on you?
Let someone return the favour this week.

khse07.title: Libra planned the trip for everyone
khse07.caption:
Planned the whole group trip and forgot to ask what you wanted?
Your wish belongs on the list too.

khse08.title: Scorpio flipped the spotlight
khse08.caption:
Answering a question with a question again?
Being guarded is allowed. Just leave one window open.

khse09.title: Sagittarius left mid-question
khse09.caption:
Always the first one out the door when things get serious?
The right person won't feel like a cage. They'll want to come along.

khse10.title: Capricorn booked the hot seat
khse10.caption:
When did you last rest without feeling guilty about it?
You don't have to earn a day off.

khse11.title: Aquarius is above the hot seat
khse11.caption:
Go quiet for a few days and hope people get it?
Tell them you're still there. It makes all the difference.

khse12.title: Pisces cried at question one
khse12.caption:
Cried at "how are you?" Same.
Big feelings usually mean a big heart. The right people will ask anyway.

khse13.title: Situationship round: Aries
khse13.caption:
Been "just talking" since spring?
Asking what this is isn't needy. It's brave.

khse14.title: Left on read round: Taurus
khse14.caption:
Read at 2:14 and it's now 9 p.m.?
A slow reply is just a slow reply. It's not a verdict on you.

khse15.title: 2 a.m. scroll round: Gemini
khse15.caption:
2 a.m., scrolling through everyone you used to know?
Put the phone down. Call a real friend tomorrow.

khse16.title: Advice giver round: Cancer
khse16.caption:
Gave the same advice to three friends this week?
Try taking it yourself. You'd tell them to.

khse17.title: Single at the dinner round: Leo
khse17.caption:
The only single one at the holiday table again?
You're not a missing seat. You're the whole guest.

khse18.title: Crush round: Virgo
khse18.caption:
Wrote a pros and cons list about your crush?
If the pros won, maybe the next step is just saying hello.

khse19.title: Breakup round: Libra
khse19.caption:
Stayed friends with everyone after the breakup, including their mum?
You're allowed to say it hurt. That isn't making it weird.

khse20.title: Missing your ex round: Scorpio
khse20.caption:
Saved their number as DON'T?
It's okay to miss being known. You can find that feeling again.

khse21.title: Flaky friend round: Sagittarius
khse21.caption:
Cancelled on your friends for the third time this month?
Show up for one small plan. It still counts.

khse22.title: New Year round: Capricorn
khse22.caption:
Long list of resolutions and not one is about love?
Try one soft goal this year: let someone in.

khse23.title: The full hot seat: Aquarius
khse23.caption:
Sixty seconds of rapid questions, and the last one gets real.
Everyone needs one person who sees the whole thing.

khse24.title: Twelve signs, one hot seat
khse24.caption:
Twelve signs, one chair, one question each. Wait for the last one.
Even the bravest sign gets nervous in the hot seat.
